# MPEG-2 Video regression vectors

`valid/` contains deterministic raw MPEG-2 Video elementary streams generated by
`tools/generate-mpeg2-test-vectors.sh` with FFmpeg's MPEG-2 encoder:

- `main-ml-progressive-ibp.m2v`: 96×64, 25 fps, Main Profile/Main Level, progressive I/P/B GOPs.
- `main-ml-interlaced-ibp.m2v`: 96×64, 25 fps, Main Profile/Main Level, interlaced frame pictures.
- `main-ml-progressive-open-gop.m2v`: 96×64, 25 fps, three open GOPs whose leading B
  pictures exercise cross-GOP dependencies and recovery random access.

The tiny coded dimensions keep the repository corpus inexpensive while exercising sequence,
GOP, picture-reordering, prediction, field-DCT, and slice syntax. `SHA256SUMS` makes accidental
corpus changes visible. The vectors are test material, not normative conformance streams.
